add_library(enet STATIC callbacks.c compress.c host.c list.c packet.c peer.c protocol.c unix.c win32.c)
target_include_directories(enet PUBLIC include)
set_target_properties(enet PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(enet PUBLIC ws2_32 winmm)
    target_compile_definitions(enet PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
else()
    include(CheckFunctionExists)
    include(CheckStructHasMember)
    include(CheckTypeSize)
    foreach(feature fcntl poll getaddrinfo getnameinfo gethostbyname_r gethostbyaddr_r inet_pton inet_ntop)
        string(TOUPPER "HAS_${feature}" definition)
        check_function_exists(${feature} ${definition})
        if(${definition})
            target_compile_definitions(enet PRIVATE ${definition}=1)
        endif()
    endforeach()
    check_struct_has_member("struct msghdr" msg_flags "sys/types.h;sys/socket.h" HAS_MSGHDR_FLAGS LANGUAGE C)
    if(HAS_MSGHDR_FLAGS)
        target_compile_definitions(enet PRIVATE HAS_MSGHDR_FLAGS=1)
    endif()
    set(CMAKE_EXTRA_INCLUDE_FILES sys/types.h sys/socket.h)
    check_type_size(socklen_t HAS_SOCKLEN_T BUILTIN_TYPES_ONLY LANGUAGE C)
    unset(CMAKE_EXTRA_INCLUDE_FILES)
    if(HAS_SOCKLEN_T)
        target_compile_definitions(enet PRIVATE HAS_SOCKLEN_T=1)
    endif()
endif()
